name: Austin Allshouse
biography: Austin Allshouse is a Research Scientist at BitSight where he applies information security, statistical modeling, and distributed computing concepts to develop quantitative methods of assessing security risk. He has a decade of experience researching the technologies and methodologies underpinning digital network surveillance systems.
